use: Collect gas evolved by a reaction and read its volume.
simulation: Volume from moles of gas formed, temperature and pressure (ideal gas), minus the dissolved part.
notes: Reference model profile: gas burette (water displacement, 100 mL)
Generic glassware, no vendor model; readings converted to 1 atm assuming ideal gas.

read.description: Read the collected gas volume (the tube must first be connected to the reaction vessel with attach_probe: device=gas_1, port=in)
